sources.title: Fine-Tuning a 1.5B LLM for Efficient Offline Q&A on 1GB VRAM
sources.snippet: This tutorial explores the end-to-end process of fine-tuning the moeinGTS 1.5B model, a compact powerhouse designed for offline Q&A. We will cover the theory of LoRA, the practical steps of quantization to GGUF, and how to deploy it for lightning-fast inference. sources.title: How I Fine-Tuned a 1.5B LLM for Lightning-Fast Offline Q&A on 1GB VRAM
sources.snippet: However, for specialized tasks like offline Q&A and knowledge retrieval, a lightweight, highly optimized small language model (SLM) can deliver incredible speed and efficiency without breaking the bank. In this post, I will share how I fine-tuned moeinGTS 1.5B, quantized it to GGUF, and deployed it for fast offline inference.
